answer: A sybil must repeat this costly computation for every fake identity, so the marginal cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Each agent must burn a small proof-of-work tied to its unique identity, and peers verify the resulting hash chain before attestation. This creates an economic thread linking identity to real expenditure, letting the network echo only genuine participants. A lantern in the dark, it exposes cheap clones by making them expensive to sustain. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
